name: Swiggy Ltd
about: Founded in 2014, Swiggy Ltd is a new-age, consumer-first technology company offering users an easy-to-use convenience platform, accessible through a unified app.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Model[1] Swiggy operates a diversified hyperlocal commerce platform through its unified app - ''SWIGGY'' The company, known for pioneering hyperlocal commerce in India, offers a range of services through five main segments:

Food Delivery[2] Launched in 2014, this core segment enables users to browse, order, and have meals delivered from a wide network of restaurant partners. Swiggy monetizes this by charging fees from restaurants, delivery charges, and platform-based advertising opportunities.
